• Therefore, the phrasal verb ''fell behind'' should be used in place of the **phrasal** verb ''fell over''.
 
• The phrasal verb ''fell behind'' means to fail to do something fast enough or on time.

• Phrasal verb ''fell over'' का अर्थ है **किसी व्यक्ति का अपना संतुलन खोना और गिरना**।
